question: The 63rd National Open Athletics Championship was conducted in the city of __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 63rd National Open Athletics Championships took place in Bengaluru, India, from August 30th to September 2nd, 2024. Here's a comprehensive overview of the event:
 
• **Key Highlights:**
 
 
• Venue: Sree Kanteerava Outdoor Stadium, Bengaluru
 
• Dates: August 30th - September 2nd, 2024
 
• Notable Absences: Olympic javelin champion Neeraj Chopra did not participate.
 
• New Records: Gulveer Singh set a new meet record in the men's 5000m race with a time of 13:54.70.
 
• Dominant Performances: Seema won gold in both the women's 5000m and 10,000m races.
 
• Race Walk Records: Amit and Payal set new meet records in the men's and women's 35km race walk events, respectively.
 
• Best Athletes: Nithin and Ancy Sojan were awarded the titles of best athletes of the championships.
 
 
 
• **Major Results:**
 
 
• Men's Javelin Throw: Vikrant Malik secured the gold medal with a throw of 80.02m in Neeraj Chopra's absence.
 
• Women's Javelin Throw: Annu Rani emerged victorious with a throw of 58.97m.
 
• Men's 100m: Lalu Prasad Bhoi clinched the gold medal with a time of 10.46 seconds.
 
• Women's 100m: Nithya Gandhe and Sneha tied for first place, both clocking 11.57 seconds.
 
• Men's 400m: Tushar Manna won the race with a time of 45.97 seconds.
 
• Women's 400m: Aishwarya Mishra secured the gold medal with a time of 53.77 seconds.
 
• Men's 5000m: Gulveer Singh set a new meet record with a time of 13:54.70.
 
• Women's 5000m: Seema won the gold medal with a time of 15:47.95.
 
• Men's 10,000m: Abhishek claimed the gold medal with a time of 29:48.18.
 
• Women's 10,000m: Seema secured her second gold medal of the championships with a time of 33:56.86.
 
• Men's Triple Jump: Mohammed SN jumped the farthest with a distance of 16.28m.
 
• Women's Triple Jump: Sheena V won the gold medal with a jump of 13.27m.
 
• Men's High Jump: Jomon Joy cleared a height of 2.14m to win the gold medal.
 
• Women's High Jump: Rekha jumped the highest with a height of 1.82m.
